title: Make the ship phase observable before the next billed run

completion_criteria.text: The live GitHub lane executes for the first time and either passes, or its failure is traced to a named root cause at path and line rather than being retried.
A boundary gate that could not collect the sides it compares parks the unit with its own refusal text instead of dispatching a fix child into a directory that was never created.
The four dispatch kinds that carry no unit become recordable, so ship and integrate can be replayed from real responses instead of hand-authored guesses.
The harness built-wait race is fixed and proven by a test red on the parent commit, so a billed run cannot be killed mid-flight and charged for nothing.
Teardown's unbounded directory removal is bounded across all three call sites, with a test proving a path outside the repository is refused.

spine.active_goal: Get the engine through a complete live run. The crash point and both hazards are closed; only a credential grant now stands between the lane and its first pass.
spine.next_step: Grant the live credential access to the harness repository: contents read and write, pull requests read and write, metadata read, and no administration. Only a human can mint or re-scope a token. Then re-trigger the lane, which costs nothing and dispatches no billed children. Merge pull requests 285 and 286 first if the trunk should carry both fixes before the run. Do not read a repeated creation error as a missing repository; the repository is verified present.
spine.last_session: 2026-08-23: created the harness repository, fixed the crash-point race that made the last billed run ship nothing, and opened pull requests 285 and 286. The re-triggered lane failed again, now on token visibility rather than on a missing repository.

open_risks.text: Treat the killed investigator's progress line about three confirmed mechanisms as nothing — it narrates work in flight, is not a finding, and citing it would carry an unverified claim into a fix

Recording a dispatch may be necessary but not sufficient for replay — the stub routes by live schema identity and resolves only four kinds, so a cassette for an unrouted kind loads, is never consumed, and can still pass
Decisions 0666 and 0674 disagree on the dispatch-kind count, twelve against eight — do not scope a fix against either number until the code has settled which vocabulary is which
Every billed run so far bought exactly one defect and stopped — about five dollars and seventeen minutes each, because each failure is terminal, so unobservable phases are what make a run expensive

Read this suite's verdict from CI rather than any local run — the primary checkout is the only honest local reader, a fresh clone adds fourteen false failures, and a linked worktree censuses an empty set

Declare work-type chore at creation on a config-only pull request — a toml file counts as source to the enforcer, and an inert work-type value is worse than none because it disables the config-only escape
Check whether an existing test already asserts the defect before calling a fix complete — two tests this session expected the broken behaviour outright, and a green suite over them hid both
Grant the live credential access to the harness repository before re-triggering anything — the repository is created and verified, so this is the only thing still blocking the lane
Never read a repeated creation error as a missing repository — the lookup returns the same empty result for a repository that is absent and for one the token simply cannot see
The crash-point fix lives in untracked harness scripts outside the repository — no suite and no enforcer covers them, so it is invisible to CI and lost if that artifacts directory is cleared
Two more unbounded recursive removals remain outside the bounded teardown — the same primitive is called directly elsewhere, so this containment does not reach them

key_decisions.title: Only work that moves the engine toward a completed live run gets done
Pre-create the harness repository instead of granting repository-creation rights
Decide the crash point from settled state instead of racing to win it
Park on a collection refusal rather than dispatching a child with nowhere to stand
The repeated creation error now means token visibility, not a missing repository
The live lane is blocked by fine-grained PAT visibility, not by a missing repository
Dispatch recording lands before the billed run; cassette harvest is deferred until after it
The two engine defects red on the trunk are fixed before the billed run, not filed
The six-versus-seven spawned-child count is a stale test expectation, not a regression
Honest inertness wording downgraded the receipts gate again; the downgrade is accepted, not re-litigated
The live GitHub lane passed for the first time, against a real repository, not a skip

out_of_scope: The billed live run itself, which is the parent thread's c45 and begins only once the credential is granted
Repairing the worktree reclaim, and the lookup that cannot tell an absent repository from an invisible one; both were filed as findings this session
